resources.access: Actual named contract and complete bounded implementations inspected
resources.reason: Bind the exact original lost-reply and split-publication question to an existing implementation and newly supplied public counterexample harness.

inspection.method: Read actual public contract/header, complete receipt implementation and both fault-model functions; inspect current nested source-bound host/VM reports.

inspection.limits: Course implementation evidence is not a published-standard inspection, external review or learner assessment.
